label: WRONG
reason: Every other package pins pytest>=9.0.3,<10.0.0 in its `test` dependency group (core, openai, groq). langchain-tests is a pytest plugin that lists pytest as a published runtime dependency, and it leaves all its runtime deps without upper bounds (pytest-asyncio>=1.3.0, syrupy>=5.0.0), so the group mixes test-only dev groups with a runtime requirement. I hesitated with ACCEPT, since keeping test-group pins aligned has some value.
